notes.title: Ver. 0.1.09 Update – Fixed known issues
notes.notes:
We sincerely apologize once again to players who encountered issues during gameplay, and thank you for your patience and feedback!

This update includes:


 Updated multilingual text
 Updated game caching method
 Improved responsiveness of event prompt windows and phone UI pop-ups
 Fixed an issue where clicking elsewhere at the moment of ejaculation would return to the selection screen
 Fixed an issue where the 【Jump to Sunday】 prompt window would appear twice in a row
 Fixed an issue where holding Ctrl while gifting items could cause the screen to freeze
 Fixed an issue with incorrect refresh rate display in fullscreen mode settings
 Fixed an issue with resolution selection in windowed mode settings
 Fixed an issue where some high-refresh-rate monitors (144Hz+) that do not support standard 60Hz caused the resolution options to be unavailable and the settings menu to be unresponsive

notes.title: Ver. 0.1.06 Update！！Bug fixes and new feature additions！！
notes.notes:
We sincerely apologize to players who encountered issues during the early stages of the game. Thank you for your patience and feedback！



Here are the details of this update:

Updated multilingual text

Optimized some image and icon aliasing issues

Added【Jump to Sunday】feature (Available once all 100% Libido events for all characters have been viewed)

Added Interactive CG to the main menu.

Added patch function for memory unlock issues (Player needs to load a save)

Fixed a rare crash issue for some players

Fixed occasional bugs preventing interaction with character schedules

Fixed player name display issue in Simplified Chinese version

Fixed VTuber name display issue in the Simplified Chinese version

Fixed issue preventing Mac players from changing settings when using virtual machines

Applied achievement patch for players who started the story but didn't receive the “Starting Today as a Manager” achievement



Thank you once again to all players for your support, feedback, and patience. We will continue listening to your voices and working hard to make the game even better！

notes.notes:

https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/44900544/fd8203705f51126e39851503cd1947dda1d7d58d.gif

【Game Overview】
https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/44900544/b5d80fd717ccd9f1ae1cd938a0712eef388e795b.gif

You are a university freshman who loves watching VTuber live streams. You entered Big Mountain Production by chance and became a manager, meeting three unique VTubers and the actual person behind the character. Over the next year, lead them towards the path of realizing their dreams!
In addition to working hard to earn money and managing channels, you can also leverage your reliable charm as a manager to gradually enter the hearts of the three girls, even developing relationships with them that goes beyond "VTuber and manager"!

https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/44900544/3edb5781b92894cd05ad05d5f035aacddf4d8151.png

【Game Features】
https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/44900544/9b60f0b31d1f2cb93e71a9c9e7ae5b01035beb5f.png


 Exquisite fully animated H scenes
 25 H scenes
 More than 180 CGs including variants
 Interactive CG in dynamic
 Three-line parallel development system
 Full voice acting for the female lead
 Dress-up system
 Over 150,000 words of text


【Game System】
-Abundant Nurturing System-
Players need to arrange the weekly schedules for the three heroines according to their abilities and goals within a year in the game, while paying attention to their physical and mental health. If players fail to relieve their stress in time, irreversible and significant consequences will occur...
Special Date System: Fulfilling specific conditions before a designated date, such as the heroine's birthday, Christmas, or Tanabata, can trigger special storylines!

https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/44900544/f7d9a934dd485c698b74bfdf726209220534f0e4.png

-Ultra-realistic Live Streaming Scenes-
With Live2D model and realistic live streaming room settings, players can experience ultra-realistic live streaming.
VTubers will encounter various unexpected events during live streams, and players need to provide appropriate action suggestions based on the heroines' characteristics!

https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/44900544/4ab425419e9ca14ab59ae2a5d0fe6e7fd85552d0.png

-Master of Time Management-
To synchronize the nurturing of three VTubers, you need to allocate action points wisely and choose which heroine's growth to witness.
Each training session is accompanied by a corresponding mini-game, and the VTubers can also grow rapidly when you perform well!

https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/44900544/799fbfed51f8c28ee8c65821215d307f2de2707f.png

notes.title: 01/20《Tower of Megami Descents》 Release!! Skillfully Utilizing the U3D Physics Engine!!
notes.notes:
The higher you stack, the happier the Goddess gets？ Can your height bring her joy！！

https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/44900544/1112a8c74ec9b8f264576c356f2cff342564092c.jpg

Game introduction
The goal of this game is to build a towering tower of ascension

Besides aiming for higher scores

the main objective of the game is to give the Megami "pleasure"

After experiencing pleasure

the Megami will reward players with "Megami Coins" based on their scores

When choosing skills, during game over, and when reaching high altitude, you can see the different appearances of the Megami

https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/44900544/445408a04c36133e85ab23e64c90d790cd0c773e.png

Gameplay
Every 10 layers stacked with "bar" will trigger the skill selection interface

In the selection interface, three out of 6 Megami skills will randomly appear

Players must choose one skill from them

Some skills' effects will last until the next skill selection

While some skills' effects will last until the game over
